name: Aventuras
storyline: Aventuras presents nine standalone stories, each beginning at a decisive moment: a crew prepares a high-stakes heist, a kingdom faces a disputed crown, a lighthouse keeper hears the tide call their name, a whistleblower weighs truth against safety, and survivors, detectives, night workers and spacefarers confront choices with lasting consequences. Every path branches according to the player's decisions and can lead to one of 32 endings across the collection.
summary: Aventuras is a bilingual collection of nine short choice-based interactive fiction stories for web browsers. Each story takes about six to ten minutes and uses branching decisions and multiple endings; the collection currently includes 32 endings across mystery, horror, science fiction, fantasy, survival, drama, comedy and thriller stories. Progress is saved automatically on the player's device. Eight stories are free and one additional science-fiction story is paid content. The game is playable in English and Spanish without an account or download. The Perfect Score is one of the included stories.
